title: Conformal Nature of Quantum Phase Transitions via Fuzzy Three-Sphere Regularization
abstract: Extends the fuzzy-sphere program to (3+1)-D via fuzzy three-sphere Landau-level regularization, and explicitly extracts Yang-Lee (non-unitary) critical spectra, verifying state-operator correspondence at a non-Hermitian critical point.
key_claims: Sphere regularization + radial quantization cleanly accesses non-unitary (Yang-Lee) CFT operator content.
State-operator correspondence verified at a non-Hermitian critical point via Landau-level projection.
Worked example is (3+1)-D, not the 2D M(2,5) minimal model.
relevance_note: WATCH / TOOLING for HYP-2026-028. A THIRD regularization strategy for non-unitary conformal data, alongside the periodic PT-chain route (PAPER-133, 2606.16785) and non-Hermitian MERA: sphere regularization sidesteps the PT-breaking edge that closed our exact-diagonalization route (SIM-053/055). Method inspiration only until someone does the 2D fuzzy-circle analog for M(2,5); no usable spectra for our chain. No bearing on the alpha=4, transport, or C_sse anchors.
